name: QR & Barcode Toolkit
tagline: Generate and scan QR codes and barcodes — vCard, Wi-Fi, URL presets, batch, all offline.
description: Generate QR codes (with presets for URL, Wi-Fi, vCard, email, SMS, geo, and plain text), and common 1D barcodes (EAN/UPC/Code128/Code39). Scan/decode QR codes from image files via OpenCV. Batch-generate from a CSV, control size/margin/error-correction, and export PNG/SVG. Fully offline.
aiStack: Python (tkinter + CLI), segno, python-barcode, OpenCV, Pillow
